answer.reason: Only one event in the verses belongs to the land itself; the rest are prophecies or mentions of the Philistines as a people.

clauses.english: had the walls of Gath, Jabneh and Ashdod broken down by Uzziah
clauses.quote: brake down the wall of Gath, and the wall of Jabneh

doubts: Most marked verses speak of the Philistines as a people or give prophecies of what is to come, so they were left out.
JDG 10:6 only names the gods of the Philistines and was left out.
EXO 15:14 and ISA 14:29-31 are prophecy, not events, and were left out.
